job.text: from the visitors--of whom there was yet a tolerable sprinkling--made a very interesting congregation; orderly, respectable, reverent; simple in dress and manner, yet many of them, both the men and women, exceedingly picturesque. That is, the old men and the old women: the younger ones aped modern fashion even here, in this out-of-the-way corner, and consequently did not look half so well as their seniors. I must name one more member of the congregation--a large black dog, who walked in and settled himself in the pew behind, where he behaved during half the service in an exemplary manner, worthy
